name: DNA polymerase eta

function.text: POLH encodes DNA polymerase eta. Annotated molecular activities include DNA polymerase activity and DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity. It participates in DNA repair and regulation of DNA repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to xeroderma pigmentosum variant type (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
